messages:
maria (support): FYI getting multiple customer reports of 401s across several hosted endpoints, started ~10:12 UTC. Customers: acme-inc, finlytics. Error shows "invalid_token". Anyone seeing auth service alerts? :rotating_light:
infra-bot: [ALERT] service=auth-publisher severity=error count=240 since 10:11:12 UTC | metric=token_publish_latency p95=4.2s p99=9.8s | link: https://graphs.redwood.internal/d/token-pub
jordan (sre): looking. Can you paste a sample error from logs or curl?
maria (support): here's a repro from customer header sample and response:
```
> curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"token not found in jwks cache"}
```
samir (infra): token-publisher job had a deploy ~10:05 UTC (image: token-pub:v3.2.1). I'm checking rollout status now.
ajex (typo: we'll keep consistent)
alex (oncall): I pushed the token-pub change, it was a small tweak to batching. Noticed some retries on staging earlier. Rolling back is quick if needed.
jordan (sre): Samir, can you confirm JWKS propagation messages? run: `kubectl get pods -l app=token-pub -o wide` and `kubectl logs token-pub-xxx | grep publish`
samir (infra): pod list looks OK but publish logs show a bunch of `ERR rate limit exceeded` around 10:09-10:13. Also seeing 502s from jwks-cache.
incident-bot: Created INC-2025-487 in incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2025-487 (sev2)
ajex (oncall): rolling back token-pub to v3.2.0 now: `kubectl set image deployment/token-pub token-pub=registry/redwood/token-pub:v3.2.0`
infra-bot: Deploy triggered by alex at 10:16 UTC; new pods coming up.
jordan (sre): monitoring auth 401s and token publish latency. Initial telemetry shows 401 rate dropping from 73/min to 8/min after rollback start.
amy (customer-success): I messaged affected customers that we're investigating and will follow up with ETA. Keeping them in the loop. :thumbsup:
maria (support): customers report recovery, 401s stopped ~10:18 UTC. Thanks team. Need RCA and customer note.
jordan (sre): creating short timeline in INC ticket and tagging eng-ml + infra. Suspect batching change increased burst on JWKS writer causing throttles on our cache layer -> tokens not visible to auth checkers. Postmortem recommended, include test/regression for JWKS write rate and a fallback grace period for cache misses.
amy (customer-success): Can we send an interim status to customers now? I can draft: "We experienced temporary auth errors due to a token publishing regression; service recovered after rollback; full postmortem to follow."
alex (oncall): +1. Will also open a PR to add rate-limit backoff and circuit-breaker to token-pub.
samir (infra): scheduling a canary + slow rollout policy for future token-pub deploys. I'll add a healthcheck on jwks-cache write latencies.
jordan (sre): assigning action items in INC-2025-487. Leaving this thread open until RCA doc exists. Thanks everyone.
